title: Jackson Memorial Hospital - Little Miracles Maternity Suites
address:
1611 NW 12th Ave, 3rd Floor
Miami, Florida 33136
United States
description:
This project renovated Jackson Memorial Hospital's maternity unit into Little Miracles Maternity Suites, bringing hospitality-style touches that make labor, delivery, and recovery feel less clinical. Private suites now come with stylish en-suite bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, and hotel-style in-room safes.

Families get overnight accommodations for a partner or guest, complimentary cappuccino, tea, and pastries, and a gourmet celebration meal for two. Patients can also upgrade to the Signature Suite Experience, which adds oversized accommodations, luxury toiletries, and enhanced menus.
